I couldn't give Marcus one settled renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co., because the records disagree. I replied in his #north-team thread with all three dates so he can check before updating the account sheet:

- **25 November:** Ilse posted this in #north-team on 14 Oct.
- **30 Nov 2026:** the signed 2025–26 renewal order form gives this as the end of the current term (the renewal date). The account profile, last updated 30 Sep, also says 30 Nov.
- **31 Dec 2026:** a CRM note from 10 Feb 2026 says this, but no other record I found backs it up.

I found nothing showing the date was formally moved to 25 Nov. I tagged Ilse in the thread and asked whether her 25 Nov replaces the contract's 30 Nov, and she hasn't answered yet.

Marcus is in #north-team and owns the account. A renewal date counts as an account fact rather than a money figure, so it was fine to share there. I left out all pricing and contract values.
